_comment: Maps this panel's channel names onto KRONOS2 vocabulary names. Use this FIRST for any marker preflight reports as novel - a mapped marker keeps the model's PRETRAINED stats and text embedding. Only fall back to additional_markers.csv for genuinely new biology.
_note_dapi: DAPI-01 needs no entry - set --kronos_nuclear_marker 'DAPI-01' (or the samplesheet nuclear_channel) and preprocess() maps it to the dapi stats directly.
